notes.title: CYBRID: MAJOR UPDATE v. 0.99
notes.notes:
[b]HELLO EVERYONE!!![/b]

[b]BIG UPDATE IS HERE[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40563687/b6f929a6776e3ca6341960c02330c92f4757440b.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=PUGWrs_hbAw;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40563687/b6f929a6776e3ca6341960c02330c92f4757440b.png[/img]

Meet [b]4[/b] new hand-crafted levels, each of which will delight you and give you new emotions in the rhythm of energetic soundtracks.

This update brings a little more than previous updates! In addition to 4 new levels in the game there is a SURVIVAL level in which the game turns into a full-fledged big Action in the World of the CYBRID game, where you can freely move around the Polish night city and kill opponents with weapons, pumping it and yourself! And most importantly, you will meet the BOSS. At the moment, this is a Demo experience. But everything depends on you, perhaps it will become a separate big game with a bunch of interesting ideas with exciting gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40563687/b6f929a6776e3ca6341960c02330c92f4757440b.png[/img]

And now about all the changes in detail:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40563687/1c91abfd9f4baba6d04d3d837ce0981a433d4692.png[/img] [b]MUSIC PACK 04:[/b]
[list]
[*] POWER
[*] VIOLENT
[*] RATHER DO
[*] BIG BOSS
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40563687/1c91abfd9f4baba6d04d3d837ce0981a433d4692.png[/img] [b]SURVIVOR DEMO EXPERIENCE[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40563687/1c91abfd9f4baba6d04d3d837ce0981a433d4692.png[/img] [b]SKINS FOR WEAPONS:[/b]
[list]
[*] SWORD
[*] BLADE
[*] GUN
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40563687/b6f929a6776e3ca6341960c02330c92f4757440b.png[/img]

[b]Also in the game the design of the main menu has been updated.[/b]

Now instead of the PUSH button you have a choice of Original levels or the inclusion of custom maps.

In the [b]CUSTOMIZATION[/b] section, the ability to increase the brightness of the TRAIL from the sword and change the Fire from the pistol has been added

Now the game temporarily lacks movement in different rooms as before after each level, this is done so that the menu is always in front of you, since for the SURVIVOR level you need to click on the front door. It will also be convenient for Streamers.

[b]Other changes:[/b]

Updated the Pause menu, now it has become prettier and matches the style of the game.

* Special update for owners of [b]VALVE INDEX CONTROLLERS[/b], now you don't have to press the trigger completely to shoot, just press it halfway, I hope this will save your controllers longer)))

Changed some Materials that were damaged due to LIV and sometimes disappeared or turned blue.

Also new [b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b] have been added to the game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40563687/b6f929a6776e3ca6341960c02330c92f4757440b.png[/img]

[b]A little more about the SURVIVOR level.[/b]

The level lasts 10 minutes, after which the Boss appears, after 5 minutes a Super update appears that needs to be unlocked after the Exclamation Mark appears.
At the level, you can collect the Points that fly out of killed enemies. Thanks to which you get the opportunity to upgrade yourself or your weapon.

[u][i]In the SURVIVOR settings menu you can adjust the movement, rotation and vignette against motion sickness[/i][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40563687/267bda639679ec6e476804c1f252b5b8f052d613.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40563687/b6f929a6776e3ca6341960c02330c92f4757440b.png[/img]

[b]Now about the important thing. I apologize for the update taking so long, but due to certain circumstances I couldn't work on the game often, but as I promised earlier the game is not abandoned, but is developing and I will not stop until the game is completely ready!!![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40563687/b6f929a6776e3ca6341960c02330c92f4757440b.png[/img]

Thank you all for waiting, I really hope you will be satisfied with this update, I tried very hard to give you incredible impressions!!!

[u][i][b]Also for everyone who supported the game at the very beginning there is a nice bonus that you can find behind your back.[/b][/i][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40563687/b6f929a6776e3ca6341960c02330c92f4757440b.png[/img]

[quote=author] [b]I WANT TO APOLOGIZE TO ALL WHO WERE WAITING FOR THIS UPDATE AND DID NOT RECEIVE IT ON TIME. DUE TO PROBLEMS THAT APPEARED THROUGH NO FAULT OF MY FAULT, I HAD TO POSTPONE THE RELEASE TO TODAY. I HOPE YOU WILL ENJOY THE GAME AND YOUR EXPECTATIONS WILL BE JUSTIFIED AND YOU WILL SPEND TIME WITH PLEASURE.[/b] [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40563687/b6f929a6776e3ca6341960c02330c92f4757440b.png[/img]

You can find out more details or discuss them in [url=https://discord.com/invite/3HPfxg2YAD]DISCORD[/url]

[b]I love everyone and see you in the FUTURE)))!!![/b]

notes.title: Update V.0.8.51
notes.notes:
Hello players! Update V.0.8.51

This is a small update that adds the following changes to the game.

Changed:
- Scoring system (Now everything depends on the rhythm of the game, even shooting)
- Spectator Camera (In the new version, a new system for setting the camera from the first and third person has been added. Now you can zoom in or out of the camera for a first-person view. For a third-person view, the ability to set the camera with your hand has been added, you can select the "Hand Control" function and place the camera in a place convenient for you with your right hand holding the "Weapon Switch" button and adjust it with the buttons in the menu)

Changes in the graphics have also been added, new visual effects have been added.

Now all the saves are in the new folder with the game, this is done for the future for the Level Editor. Now the saves are in "CYBRID\Saved\SaveGames\GameSettings", in connection with this the game settings will be reset, for which I am very sorry, for this the game is in Early Access, in the future such cardinal changes will not occur.

Thank you all for playing and supporting the game!!!

See you in the future!

notes.title: New Test Update V0838-2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I am glad to present Updates for those who are interested in taking part in the Beta Testing of new game features before they appear in the main version.

Below is how to enable it and what has been added or changed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40563687/3743624b6d5487ffd743f77e2a8b3a17be837b71.png[/img] 

In order to switch to the Beta version, you need to: Right-click on the shortcut of the game in Steam, then select Properties and in the Beta section, select "Beta" from the drop-down menu. To return to the regular version, simply select "-"

-Now the direction of the blows are visible through the opponents in front, which improves the visibility of the next blow
-The direction of the blows is slightly highlighted by the color of the objects, which improves the visibility of which sword to strike
-Now after hitting the enemy, points received for hitting appear
-Simplified and improved interface displaying your points, lives and x-combo
-Changed and Animated "Special Level 3"
-Conducted Optimization
-Removed the ability to select 120 fps in the settings, instead you can select 144 fps which will improve the display, (120 fps did not work correctly)

If you find a bug in the game, I will be very grateful if you report it in the game's Community or in the game's Discord channel: https://discord.com/invite/3HPfxg2YAD

Great games everyone and see you in the future!

notes.title: Update v0.8.38 Released
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40563687/e7a12011de06971d558c0d980fa3f8cba29eb6fc.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Meet the new big update!


- Added 3 levels of difficulty for all levels.

- Added reloading at the bottom of the belt.

- Fixed hitboxes of enemies with a sword, now it's easier to hit them.

- Fixed blades, now they have correct hitboxes

- Added leaderboard

- Fixed the disappearance of vibration when modifying "Fast speed"

- Added a warning before starting the game that the game may be inconvenient for some people.

- Optimization of complex effects that could load the system was carried out, and work was also carried out to optimize the animation of opponents.

- The scoring system has also changed.

- Fixed a bug due to which after passing a level, the "Score for passing" was not displayed

- Added the ability to select a color for each sword separately.

- Fixed problems with the TRAINING level.

- Added selection of sounds for Swords, Blades and Pistols in the Customization section

-Added the ability to tilt and position the hands in the Setting - Character section.

- In addition, a number of minor bugs have been fixed that did not affect the game, but were noticed.


[i]- Since I changed the training system, after the first launch, it will require you to go through it before starting, if you have already completed it, then just go to the training and exit. This is a small innovation that will help many people not to make mistakes when starting the game for the first time.[/i]


If you find a bug in the game, I will be very grateful if you report it in the game's Community or in the game's Discord channel: https://discord.com/invite/3HPfxg2YAD

Great games everyone and see you in the future!
